parameters.content:
## AI Station meeting summary

1. Run `ai n8n configure` and attach Header Auth `Authorization: Bearer <LLM_API_KEY>` from `projects/n8n.env` to LiteLLM Summary.
2. Call only `http://llm-gateway:4000/v1` from inside Compose. Never `:8888` or llama.cpp ports.
3. Canonical model: `Qwen3.8-27B-UD-Q4_K_M`.
4. Paste notes or a transcript into Set notes. Do not commit calendar credentials.

assignments.name: notes
assignments.value: Weekly ops. Ali: backup ran, restore dry-run still missing a qualifying archive. Sam: Open WebUI Knowledge upload of the Q3 PDF succeeded. Next: enable retention after the owner picks 90 days.
